constraint.title: The bead must stay on the circle
constraint.caption: Every allowed point is 5 m from the centre. The marked point is 3 m across and 4 m up. The axes have equal physical scale.

pendulum-potential.title: Lifting the pendulum raises its energy
pendulum-potential.caption: Zero energy is at the bottom. For the example’s mass and length, angle π/3 gives 10 J; the upright position needs 40 J.

phase-point.title: One point gives position and momentum
phase-point.caption: The dot is at position +2 m and momentum −6 kg·m/s. It means right of zero and moving left. The upright axis is momentum, not another direction in space.

local-stability.title: The bottom pushes back after a nudge
local-stability.caption: This potential has its minimum at zero. Moving a little either way raises energy, so the force points back toward zero.

circular-orbit-radius.title: A circular orbit sits at the minimum
circular-orbit-radius.caption: For the example’s angular momentum and attraction, the effective potential has its minimum at radius 2 m. The curve includes the turning-energy term.

nonlinear-force.title: The force grows faster than a straight rule
nonlinear-force.caption: At displacement 2 m, the full restoring force is −12 N. The dashed line shows just the linear part, which would give −4 N.

pendulum-energy-contour.title: One motion follows one energy loop
pendulum-energy-contour.caption: This loop has energy 2 J. At angle zero it crosses momentum +2 and −2 kg·m²/s. At the left and right ends the momentum is zero and the swing turns back. This is phase space, not the pendulum’s path in the room.

pendulum-energy-barrier.title: Thirty joules cannot reach the top
pendulum-energy-barrier.caption: The potential reaches 40 J at the upright angles ±π. The 30 J total-energy line meets it earlier, so the pendulum turns back.

pendulum-separatrix.title: The boundary reaches 4 rad/s at the bottom
pendulum-separatrix.caption: For the stated pendulum, these two branches separate swinging from full rotation. At ±π the boundary speed is zero. This is a graph of angle and rate, not a path through space.

sensitive-dependence.title: A small starting gap grows
sensitive-dependence.caption: The local estimate doubles from 0.001 to 0.002 and then 0.004. This short-interval model is not a guarantee of unlimited growth.
